content.short: RedStone provides fast, gas-efficient cross-chain data feeds as a blockchain oracle for DeFi protocols and institutions.
content.description: RedStone delivers reliable, real-time financial data to blockchains for decentralized applications. Traditional oracle solutions are slow, expensive, or can't support the diverse range of assets that institutional DeFi requires. RedStone's modular architecture provides access to over 1,200 price feeds, enabling DeFi lending platforms to verify collateral values and tokenized asset protocols that price real-world assets like treasuries and private credit. Our infrastructure serves as the official oracle for major institutional players, including BlackRock's BUIDL fund, making it easier for developers to integrate production-grade oracle solutions that scale with their needs.
